# Renew Implant Centre

> Dental implant and denture clinic in Orléans (Ottawa), Ontario. A surgeon, a denturist (Tom Szarski, DD), and an on-site dental lab plan and build full arch implants, All-on-4, same-day implants, and implant-supported dentures under one roof. Free consultations include a 3D scan. Prices are quoted only after that consultation.

## Start here

- [Am I a candidate for dental implants? (quiz)](https://www.renewimplants.ca/implant-candidate-quiz): Nine questions that show which implant path people in a similar situation explore.
- [Pricing and financing](https://www.renewimplants.ca/pricing): Payment plans, CDCP, and insurance.
- [What to expect](https://www.renewimplants.ca/what-to-expect): The consultation-to-final-teeth timeline.
- [Contact](https://www.renewimplants.ca/contact-us): Address, hours, and phone.
